topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: It’s a funny thing, trust. You think you know a guy, you sit in the same greasy spoon, swap stories over coffee that’s half-cold by the time it hits the table. Turns out, those stories got more holes in them than the bottom of a cheap dime-store coffee cup. Friend of mine, always said he worked nights at some high-flying office downtown. Big words, fancy suits. Found out today, he’s been sweeping floors at the same place half the block over from where we grab our crumpled-up bacon and sputtering eggs. Should’ve seen it, maybe. But then, you start to wonder, what else has he been spinning? What else did I miss? Guess it’s time to go for a long walk in the rain and think this over.
